items.title: Al Ghurair appoints main contractor for Weave in JVC
items.summary: Julfar Contracting is now building the 130-home project of one- to three-bedroom apartments, with enabling works finished early and substructure 70% done. Completion is targeted for Q2 2028.

items.project: Four Seasons Private Residences Dubai at DIFC
items.title: Four Seasons promotes its DIFC private residences
items.summary: Al Khaleej reported 52 homes across four David Chipperfield-designed towers, with H&H overseeing delivery for Bright Start. The project was first announced in 2024, and H&H’s own page now lists 59 residences and 2029 completion.

items.title: Sol Properties launches Sol Terra Gardens in JVC District 11
items.summary: The launch calendar lists studios and one- and two-bedroom homes with 30,000 sq ft of amenities, from AED 750,000 (one broker quotes AED 730,000). Handover is planned for Q4 2029.

items.project: Radisson Residences Al Reem Island – Phase 2
items.title: Royal Development adds third Radisson tower on Al Reem
items.summary: Phase Two of the AED 1.45bn project has 437 furnished studios and one-bedroom apartments plus a few two-bedroom townhouses, aimed at investors. Phase One sold out within 24 hours.

items.title: Fakhruddin unveils robot-assisted Tréppan Vision in DLRC
items.summary: The AED 700m mixed-use scheme has 408 apartments (252 studios, 108 one-beds, 48 two-beds), 48 offices and seven shops, with eight robotic services. Completion is scheduled for Q4 2029.

items.title: Arada opens sales at Layan, fifth phase of Masaar 3
items.summary: The phase has 437 two- to five-bedroom villas and townhouses in the forest community in Rowdat, with more than two thirds being three- and four-bedroom homes.

items.title: RAK Properties launches Lunara, first community at The Strand
items.summary: The three connected towers hold 583 one- and two-bedroom apartments and a three-bedroom penthouse. Construction was due to start in Q4 2026, with completion expected in Q1 2029.
